referenceFunction.includedProcesses: burdens in the municipal waste incineration process which are not attributable to a specific waste component, but are depending on operating conditions (temperature, oxygen concentrations etc.). Air emissions, burdens from emissions and abatement of thermal NOx, water consumption.
referenceFunction.name: Process-specific burdens, municipal waste incineration

technology.text: average Swiss municipal soild waste incineration plants in 2000 with grate incinerator, with electrostatic precipitator for fly ash (ESP), wet flue gas scrubber and 29.4% SNCR , 32.2% SCR-high dust , 24.6% SCR-low dust -DeNOx facilities and 13.8% without Denox (by burnt waste, according to Swiss average).
